headline: Walang Pasok: Brief Lists August 17 Class Suspensions in Parts of Luzon
seoTitle: Walang Pasok: August 17 Class Suspensions in Parts of Luzon
seoDescription: An FMB News overnight brief lists localized in-person class suspensions for Monday, August 17, amid persistent monsoon flooding.
deck: Selected LGUs shifted away from face-to-face classes as saturated ground and flood risks persisted.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The August 17 FMB News overnight brief reports in-person class suspensions in selected LGUs in Cavite, Batangas, Bulacan and Pampanga, citing local safety concerns after prolonged monsoon rainfall.
The brief specifically names General Trias, Nasugbu, Calumpit, Hagonoy and Apalit. Coverage can change through the morning, so readers should still check their LGU and school for the latest scope.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Local suspension orders may differ by school level, public or private status and learning modality. The article therefore does not imply a Luzon-wide or Metro Manila-wide cancellation.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Clear local suspension information helps families avoid unnecessary travel through flooded or unsafe roads while schools activate alternative learning arrangements.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch LGU, school and PAGASA advisories for additional suspensions, resumptions or changes in learning modality.
